1: // Asteroid Rescue – minimal implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10: 
11:   // Game state
12:   let points = 0;
13:   let fuel = 100; // percent
14:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 60, w: 30, h: 40, speed: 3 };
15:   const keys = {};
16:   const asteroids = [];
17:   const astronauts = [];
18: 
19:   // Helpers
20:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
21:   const rectIntersect = (a, b) =>
22:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
23: 
24:   // Input
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
27: 
28:   // Spawn functions
29:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
30:     const size = rand(20, 50);
31:     asteroids.push({
32:       x: rand(0, width - size),
33:       y: -size,
34:       w: size,
35:       h: size,
36:       speed: rand(1, 3)
37:     });
38:   };
39: 
40:   const spawnAstronaut = () => {
41:     const size = 20;
42:     astronauts.push({
43:       x: rand(0, width - size),
44:       y: -size,
45:       w: size,
46:       h: size,
47:       speed: rand(1, 2)
48:     });
49:   };
50: 
51:   // Main loop
52:   let frame = 0;
53:   const update = () => {
54:     // Move ship
55:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
56:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
57:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
58:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
59:     // Keep within bounds
60:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
61:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y));
62: 
63:     // Fuel drain
64:     if (frame % 60 === 0) fuel = Math.max(0, fuel - 0.2);
65: 
66:     // Spawn entities
67:     if (frame % 90 === 0) spawnAsteroid();
68:     if (frame % 300 === 0) spawnAstronaut();
69: 
70:     // Update asteroids
71:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
72:       const a = asteroids[i];
73:       a.y += a.speed;
74:       // Collision with ship → lose
75:       if (rectIntersect(ship, a)) {
76:         endGame();
77:         return;
78:       }
79:       // Remove off‑screen
80:       if (a.y > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
81:     }
82: 
83:     // Update astronauts
84:     for (let i = astronauts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
85:       const a = astronauts[i];
86:       a.y += a.speed;
87:       if (rectIntersect(ship, a)) {
88:         points += 10;
89:         astronauts.splice(i, 1);
90:         continue;
91:       }
92:       if (a.y > height) astronauts.splice(i, 1);
93:     }
94: 
95:     // Lose if no fuel
96:     if (fuel <= 0) {
97:       endGame();
98:       return;
99:     }
100: 
101:     draw();
102:     frame++;
103:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
104:   };
105: 
106:   const draw = () => {
107:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
108:     // Ship – simple triangle
109:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
110:     ctx.beginPath();
111:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
112:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
113:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
114:     ctx.closePath();
115:     ctx.fill();
116:     // Asteroids – gray circles
117:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
118:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
119:       ctx.beginPath();
120:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
121:       ctx.fill();
122:     });
123:     // Astronauts – blue squares
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
125:     astronauts.forEach(a => {
126:       ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h);
127:     });
128:     // UI
129:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
130:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
131:     ctx.fillText(`Points: ${points}`, 10, 20);
132:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${fuel.toFixed(1)}%`, 10, 40);
133:   };
134: 
135:   const endGame = () => {
136:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
137:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
139:     ctx.font = 'bold 32px sans-serif';
140:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
141:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
142:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${points}`, width / 2, height / 2 + 40);
143:   };
144: 
145:   // Start the loop
146:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
147: })();

(End of file - total 147 lines)
